dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Help! I accidentally ordered 25 kilograms of bamboo shoots... If my family finds out, they'll lose their minds, and I might loss my head! Please, someone, buy them off me!"

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "What are bamboo shoots? What are they for?"

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: "It's a special ingredient that a merchant from Liyue recommended to me. They said it's used to make delicious 'Bamboo Shoot Soup' or 'Triple-Layered Consommé'... So I wanted to buy some to try..."

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "Doesn't sound like anything I know how to work with... Maybe you should ask Katya at Speranza. She's got a super chef over there, and they might be able to make use of your bamboo shoots."
